note: Gated the candle/qwen3 backend behind a default-off 'qwen3' cargo feature (vqtrs-core + cli/api passthroughs). cfg-gated the candle imports, Qwen3 Inner variant + load/embed arms, Resolved::Qwen3, and resolve_dense (helpful error when off). Verified: default build pulls 0 candle deps and errors clearly on Qwen3 models; --features qwen3 pulls candle (3) and embeds Qwen3. clippy/fmt/tests clean in BOTH configs.

Implemented the local UDS channel. vqtrs-api now serves all routes over a Unix socket (default $XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/vqtrs.sock, --socket/--no-socket) alongside TCP. CLI embed/sparse/m3/rerank transparently route to a warm daemon over the socket (sync HTTP/1.1 client, no async/extra deps), falling back in-process when down or when an explicit --model/--no-daemon is given. service status shows the live socket. Verified live: all 4 commands route to the daemon (returned the daemon's distinct model), --no-daemon forces in-process, and fallback works when the daemon is down. Also hardened socket-path resolution to require XDG_RUNTIME_DIR to actually exist. clippy/fmt/tests clean.
